newsitem.title: USA: Enron to allow open access in 4 Ore. cities.
newsitem.headline: Enron to allow open access in 4 Ore. cities.

text.p: Portland General Electric Co (PGE), a subsidiary of Enron Corp, said Wednesday it plans to file to allow 50,000 customers in Hillsboro, Oregon City, Sandy, and St. Helens, Oregon, to buy power from competing suppliers by the end of the year.
The program, part of an agreement between the companies and Oregon Public Utility Commission, will be available to all customer classes.

"Although customers may choose to purchase electricity from companies other than PGE, the power will be delivered over PGE's existing distribution system," said Peggy Fowler, president and chief operating officer of distribution operations at PGE.
